item.title: August 10, 2026 - Regular prayer and meditation
item.description: Page 232. "Most of us pray when we are hurting. We learn that if we pray regularly, we won't be hurting as often or as intensely." Just for Today: I will make a commitment to include regular prayer and meditation in my new pattern of living.
